description: Liste des barrages dans le bassin hydraulique de Souss Massa is a data set listed in Morocco national open data portal (data.gov.ma), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Agence du Bassin Hydraulique de Souss Massa. Ce fichier présente les données sur les barrages dans le bassin de Souss Massa. Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Agence du Bassin Hydraulique de Souss Massa. Its tags are Barrage, Bassin hydraulique Sous Massa, Environnement, Région. It offers 2 resource(s) in QGIS, XLSX. The portal shows 2023-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support dam, reservoir and flood defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-ma-portal.
